Added a `test-minds-linux-install` CI job, in both the internal workflow and the public-mirror overlay: it runs `apps/minds/scripts/install-linux.sh --yes --no-launch --skip-docker` from the checkout on `ubuntu-latest` and asserts the pinned Node and pnpm, the Electron dependencies, the bundled git at its pinned version, the built UI bundle, the launcher, and `uv run minds run --help`. The root README's "For development" section points Linux users at the installer.

The private `just minds-start` and `just minds-start-cloud` recipes now end by running `apps/minds/scripts/start-desktop.sh` instead of selecting Node, hand-building the frontend, and running `pnpm start` themselves; the hand-built frontend step duplicated what `pnpm start`'s prestart already does. Because that script syncs the Electron dependencies itself, the recipes no longer refuse to start when `apps/minds/node_modules` is missing; `just minds-install` remains the way to get the pinned pnpm onto a fresh machine.
